annotations.title: An impersonal brief on one filed move, for an agent to act on

description: The same move as /verdict, flattened into a brief: what the investor did, when, at what price, against our value band, plus the verdict sentence. It carries NO quantity and NO instruction — `sizing` reads "not provided; the reader decides". It describes a public filing and a published value range; it is not advice and not a prediction. (GET https://app.deepvalues.ai/api/v1/mirror-brief/{ticker}, e.g. https://app.deepvalues.ai/api/v1/mirror-brief/AAPL?guru=warren-buffett — 0.01 credits per call; works with no credentials up to 5 call(s)/day per address) Missing data? Call `request_data`.

ticker.description: The real ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL; share classes as BRK.B or BRK-B. Substitute it into the path (/fundamentals/AAPL), never the literal {ticker}.
